episodes.title: Asa and Yuru
episodes.summary: In a world where certain humans command mighty supernatural duos called Daemons, it is the birthright of "the children who sunder day and night"—twins Yuru and Asa—to rule over these powerful entities. Separated from a young age and unaware of the truth of their birth, brother and sister must fight to make their way back to each other, claim their birthright, and save the world...

episodes.title: Left and Right
episodes.summary: Guided by Dera, Yuru flees from his pursuers and awakens the guardian deities of the village.

episodes.title: Dera and Hana
episodes.summary: Yuru learns the truth about his village and learns the rules of modern society as he rides down the mountain.

episodes.title: Jin and Yuru
episodes.summary: After a short rest, Yuru and his Daemons begin their search for Asa by sniffing out her blood.

episodes.title: Hare and Tortoise
episodes.summary: Yuru and his Daemons track the scent of Asa's blood to a warehouse, where they encounter Jin and his men.

episodes.title: The Kagemori Clan and the Unknown Assailants
episodes.summary: Yuru is reunited with Asa at the Kagemori mansion and asks her about their parents.

episodes.title: Asa and Break
episodes.summary: The morning after the battle, Yuru asks about the eyepatch covering her right eye.

episodes.title: Suspicion and Conviction
episodes.summary: Dera arrives at the Kagemori mansion to retrieve Yuru, and they're invited to breakfast by the clan head.

episodes.title: Embrace and Whisper
episodes.summary: In order to cheer Yuru up, Dera drags him and his Daemons around the city to see the sights.

episodes.title: Long-Arm and Long-Leg
episodes.summary: While shopping in the city, Yuru and Dera sense that they're being followed.

episodes.title: Big Brother and Little Brother
episodes.summary: After defeating Long-Arm and Long-Leg, the group realizes something else had been tailing them all along.

episodes.title: Retainer and Shaman
episodes.summary: Ken moves in with Yuru and the others and asks Yuru to help him become stronger.

episodes.title: Daikyo and Shokyo
episodes.summary: Higashi Village is attacked by a man wielding katana Daemons.

episodes.title: Family and Friends
episodes.summary: Yuru and Ken notice someone following them while looking for a place to practice shooting a bow.

episodes.title: Yuru and Danji
episodes.summary: Feeling betrayed by Danji, Yuru asks for space so he can think by himself.

episodes.title: Kagemori and Shingo
episodes.summary: Yuru and Dera head to the warehouses at night to meet Ivan.

episodes.title: Crybaby and Naughty Child
episodes.summary: The traitor attacks Asa while she's alone, but the Kagemoris have set a trap for him.

episodes.title: Fujin and Raijin
episodes.summary: At the Kagemori mansion, the traitor is captured. Meanwhile, Gonzo overpowers the Shingo clan.

episodes.title: Sword and Bow
episodes.summary: Asa rescues the hostages, and Yuru faces off against Ivan.

episodes.title: The Hunted and the Hunter
episodes.summary: After an intense battle, Ivan escapes. He teleports back to Shingo, who appears to be in trouble.

episodes.title: Zashiki-Warashi and Higashi Village
episodes.summary: Yuru and his twin sister, Asa, find themselves in the midst of a mysterious and supernatural world of Daemons.

episodes.title: The Kagemori Brothers and the Kuroya Siblings
